text:
Sophia: Quick heads-up — int8 bringup for nova13b is showing a quality regression on structured-output tasks (JSON/tool-calling). 3/50 golden cases failed strict JSON match :frowning:
Ana: Oy. Do you have an example?
Sophia: Yep, here’s one (expected vs int8 output):
```
EXPECTED:
{"action":"create_ticket","args":{"title":"Crash on save","priority":"high"}}
INT8_OUTPUT:
{"action":"create_ticket","args": "title: Crash on save, priority: high"}
```
Ana: That looks like the model flattened the args into a string. Might be tokenizer/quote handling.
Mike: Could also be a decode-kernel fallback on int8 that loses structured boundaries. Any logs from the runtime? :eyes:
Sophia: Runtime shows a few kernel fallbacks during generation. I’ll paste later. For quick repro you can run:
```bash
python eval.py --model nova13b-int8 --golden tests/structured_gold.json --filter task=tool_call --strict-json
```
Raj: Two things to check: 1) tokenizer change (were we using tokenizer-v2 for this run?), 2) sampling temp/schedule differences between int8 and fp16 runs.
Mike: I remember a tokenizer tweak last week that changes how colons/commas are tokenized inside braces. That could cause the model to prefer a different reconstruction.
Jules: label-bot just flagged 45 examples in the golden set as "ambiguous-structure" after the automated sanity check.
label-bot: Reassigning 45 items to @Jules for re-annotation (priority: high). See queue #structured-recheck.
Jules: I can take the batch, starting tomorrow. ETA ~48h for initial pass.
Ana: For labeling guidance: prefer preserving JSON native types (objects/arrays) over inline stringified args. If annotator is unsure, mark as 'needs-dev-review'.
Sophia: Agreed. Also we need 200 additional focused cases for nested args and function-call params to expand the golden coverage.
Mike: I can spin a generation job (sampling from existing prompts + perturbations) to propose candidates. Will dump into a review bucket.
Raj: When we re-eval, let's run both strict-json and structural-levenshtein metrics. Thresholds: strict-json pass rate >= 98%, structural-levenshtein <= 0.03 for accept.
Sophia: Sounds good. Also plan to run canary on Dedicated pool with tag `qcanary/novaint8` before rolling to hosted. Mike can you do that?
Mike: Yep — will launch canary with 5000 requests and a diff checkout. Command I’ll use:
```bash
redwood deploy canary --pool dedicated-small --model nova13b-int8 --tag qcanary/novaint8 --eval tests/structured_gold.json
```
Jules: For the re-annotation, can you share the sampling script? I want to prioritize nested fields + edge unicode cases.
Mike: Dropping script here: `scripts/sample_structured_candidates.py --min-nested 1 --unicode-weight 0.2 --out /tmp/candidates.jsonl`
Sophia: I'll open a tiny golden-patch PR with 200 candidates (generated+human-labeled) and tag eng-ml + eng-runtime. Will also attach failing examples and kernel logs.
Ana: Thanks — ping when PR is up, I’ll audit the annotation guidelines and do a quick sweep.
Raj: After annotation and canary, if we still fail, we should consider a micro-fine-tune with 1k structured examples or revert the tokenizer change for int8 path.
Sophia: Noted. For now, action items: Mike -> generate candidate pool + run canary (ETA today), Jules -> re-annotate 45 flagged items (start tomorrow), Sophia -> open golden PR when annotation done, Ana -> audit guidelines.
:sparkles: :thumbsup:
